headline: OpenAI reportedly disbanded its preparedness team
summary: OpenAI reportedly shut down its preparedness team last month. This team assessed AI model risks and developed mitigation strategies. The move raises concerns about future AI safety and potential rogue models.

headline: Open Mike Eagle and Kenny Segal crafted a hip hop breakup masterpiece
summary: Open Mike Eagle and Kenny Segal released their new album, "DOOMED!". The record is described as a "hip hop breakup masterpiece." Eagle explores personal subject matter, transforming a common theme into artistic gold.

headline: Amazon is trying to crush class-action suits before they get started
summary: Amazon updated its terms, requiring disputes to be resolved through arbitration. The new terms include a class action waiver, blocking collective lawsuits. Critics say this limits user rights, despite Amazon calling it "fast and efficient."

headline: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
summary: ChatGPT's macOS app now features "Computer History." It tracks user activity, including clicks and keystrokes, to learn work habits. This data helps ChatGPT suggest automations and pick up unfinished tasks.

headline: Avengers: Doomsday Trailer Sparks Theories About 2 Doctor Dooms as Fans Hope for a Surprise Cameo from Cillian Murphy
summary: The new Avengers: Doomsday trailer hints at the possibility of two Doctor Dooms. Fans are speculating about a potential surprise cameo. Cillian Murphy's name has been floated as a desired addition to the cast.

headline: The Best Deals Today: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth for Switch 2, Nioh 3, Project Hail Mary, and More
summary: A roundup of top deals for gamers and tech enthusiasts. Highlighted items include Final Fantasy VII Rebirth for Switch 2 and Nioh 3. Also features offers on Project Hail Mary and other popular products.

headline: Simu Liu Says Sleeping Dogs Movie Has 'a REAL Path Forward' Amid Dealmaking With Square Enix
summary: Simu Liu provides an optimistic update on the Sleeping Dogs movie. The adaptation has "a REAL path forward," according to the Marvel star. Discussions are ongoing with game publisher Square Enix to finalize the deal.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Becomes First Spider-Man Movie to Reach $2 Billion in Theaters
summary: "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" has crossed $2 billion globally at the box office. This marks a historic first for any Spider-Man film. The movie achieves a significant theatrical landmark for the Marvel hero.

headline: Trump envoy Kushner meets Hamas leader to push Gaza peace plan
summary: Trump's envoy, Jared Kushner, held a rare meeting with a Hamas leader. The meeting aims to advance a Gaza peace plan. This follows Israel's recent rejection of Donald Trump's peace proposal.

headline: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026
summary: Russia reports at least seven deaths in a major Ukrainian attack. Moscow calls it the largest attack of 2026. Deadly Russian strikes also hit Kyiv overnight, causing fires.

headline: Five teenagers dead and four injured after car drives on wrong side of motorway
summary: A tragic accident on the M9 Northbound left five teenagers dead. Four others were injured in the collision in County Kildare. The car was driving on the wrong side of the motorway early Sunday.

headline: Emergency phone alert put domestic abuse victims at risk, campaigners say
summary: An emergency phone alert surprised millions on Friday night. Campaigners warn it may have endangered domestic abuse victims. The sudden alert could have revealed hidden phones or safe locations.
